description: Deletes a task outright, as the task menu's Delete does. It cannot be undone; to say a task is not needed, use skip_task instead. Deleting a Scanner's task tells that Scanner it was wrong. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first delete's answer.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_task
title: Delete a task
